reason: An independent review of PR #295 found defects that make this freeze unfit to authorize a paid run. No run used it. It is kept byte for byte as failed pre-run evidence.
findings: The run compared only the digest a freeze declares, and did not authenticate the freeze body.
The $1.00 ceiling rested on an estimate of characters per token, and a failed call was not charged a full bound.
The scorer did not require exactly one record per frozen case, and regrading did not check sealed evidence.
An answer with no returned model passed the wrong_model bar.
The held-out cohort carried Golden-derived content, and two requests carried a customer name.
Six labels set sourceAlreadyPresent false where the source is on file, which disabled a hard bar.
heldout-missing-02 and heldout-document-04 needed owner adjudication.
